readOnly.title: Your account is read-only
readOnly.body: You can view your data, but changes are paused until your subscription is active again. Reactivate to resume managing your hotel.

pastDue.title: Payment past due
pastDue.body: We couldn't process your latest payment. Update your billing details to avoid losing access.

expired.title: Your subscription has expired
expired.body: Renew your subscription to restore full access to your dashboard.

canceled.title: Your subscription is canceled
canceled.body: Reactivate your subscription to continue managing your hotel.

locked.title: This hotel is currently unavailable
locked.body: Access has been temporarily paused. Please contact the platform administrator for assistance.
